content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm searching for a function in [product_name] similar to the 'MOVE' instruction found in [version_no]. I want to assign a value to VW0. Could someone guide me on how to do this? Any suggestions are welcome. Thanks, [user_name]
Hello, refer to the FAQ at [url]. This method works.
Use the Tools > Parameter VM Mapping option in the menu toolbar. This allows you to add the blocks to the VM.
